name: grant_item

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GrantItem resolves the top item ID through func_001479C0, dispatches its fixed descriptor to the stock-item or character-ability grant routine, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_001479C0 indexes the two-byte item descriptor table at D_0054C360. Descriptor type 0 calls func_0013C970 to increase the item's owned count; type 1 calls func_0013C858 to insert the encoded ability into the descriptor-selected character's ability list. The two JP calls grant literal item IDs 24 and 36 immediately after their respective reward text sequences in pc06.ard and pc12.ard.
